chunks: The illustrious Shaykh Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us in the house of Sayyid Abu Muhammad. He said: Ibrahim ibn Ishaq al-Talaqani (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abu Ahmad Abd al-Aziz ibn Yahya ibn Ahmad ibn Isa al-Juludi al-Basri narrated to us in Basra in the year 317 AH. He said: al-Husayn ibn Humayd narrated to us. He said: Yahya ibn Abd al-Hamid al-Himmani narrated to us. He said: Qays ibn al-Rabi' narrated to us from al-A'mash, from Abaya ibn Rib'i, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's blessings be upon him and his family) said:

Indeed, Allah the Mighty and Majestic divided creation into two parts and placed me in the better part. That is His saying, the Mighty and Majestic, regarding the companions of the right and the companions of the left. I am from the companions of the right, and I am the best of the companions of the right. Then He made the two parts into thirds, and placed me in the best third. That is His saying, the Mighty and Majestic:

"The companions of the right hand - how blessed are the companions of the right hand! The companions of the left hand - how wretched are the companions of the left hand! And the foremost are the foremost" (56:8-10),
I am from the foremost, and I am the best of the foremost. Then He made the thirds into tribes, and placed me in the best tribe. That is His saying, the Mighty and Majestic:
"We made you into nations and tribes so that you may know one another. Surely, the noblest of you in the sight of Allah are the most God-fearing of you" (49:13),

I am the most God-fearing of the descendants of Adam, and the noblest of them in the sight of Allah, Exalted is His praise - and I do not boast. Then He made the tribes into families, and placed me in the best family. That is His saying, the Mighty and Majestic:
"Allah only desires to keep the uncleanness away from you, O People of the House, and to purify you with a thorough purification" (33:33).

key_terms.أصحاب اليمين: Companions of the Right - Quranic term for the blessed
key_terms.أهل البيت: Ahl al-Bayt - People of the House, the Prophet's household
key_terms.السابقون: The Foremost - Quranic designation for the highest category of believers
key_terms.قسمين: Two parts - referring to God's division of humanity into two groups

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say about his status in the divine division of creation?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) explains how God progressively selected and elevated him through successive divisions of creation - from two groups to thirds, then tribes, and finally families - citing Quranic verses at each stage to demonstrate divine endorsement. This hadith, narrated through Ibn Abbas, was likely used to establish the special status of the Prophet's lineage, culminating in the Verse of Purification (33:33) about Ahl al-Bayt.
word_analysis: so that you may know one another
